en.headline: Three-alarm fire breaks out at Lau Fau Shan wood warehouse
en.dek: Fire Services upgraded the blaze at a Kai Pak Ling Road warehouse storing timber shortly after 1.15pm; 28 people were evacuated and no injuries were reported.
body: A three-alarm fire broke out at a warehouse storing timber in Feng Jiang Village, Lau Fau Shan, on Thursday afternoon. The Fire Services Department received the first reports at about 1.15pm and upgraded the incident to three alarms at 1.29pm.

The warehouse is located on Kai Pak Ling Road. Firefighters laid long hose lines because the site was distant from water sources. Two breathing-apparatus teams and two jets were deployed. About 23 men and five women were evacuated. No injuries were reported and no dangerous goods were said to be stored on the premises.
The Fire Services Department advised residents affected by drifting smoke or odour to close windows and remain calm. The cause of the fire remained under investigation.

zh.headline: 流浮山木材貨倉三級火 28人疏散無人傷
zh.dek: 消防下午約1時15分接報雞伯嶺路鳳降村貨倉起火，1時29分升為三級，現場存放木材，需遠距離拖喉灌救。
body: 流浮山鳳降村一間存放木材的貨倉周四下午發生火警。消防處約下午1時15分接獲報告，並於1時29分將火警升為三級。
貨倉位於雞伯嶺路。由於火場遠離水源，消防人員需在逾百米外拖喉展開撲救，並出動兩隊煙帽隊及兩條喉。現場約有23男5女疏散，暫未接獲有人受傷報告，亦無危險品存放。
消防處呼籲受煙霧或異味影響的市民關閉門窗及保持鎮定。起火原因有待調查。
